scope: Reusable offline source-coordinate support and record joins; not the paired recorder or live qualification.

verification.offline_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware and not firmware and not browser'

contract.joining: One decision per input record; complete/incomplete/unobservable and trigger/no-trigger remain distinct. Trigger choice does not change selected pilot IQ.

limitations: Identity equality is not serial/boot/RF/manifest attestation.
INCLUDED establishes per-record geometry, not continuous1s coverage, map/request ledger continuity, health or lock.
Initial maps may be unobservable because of filter history or conservativeFFT-envelope underflow; retain rather than clamp/drop.
Actual first-to-last-center span differs from nominal sample-count/rate exposure.
30/60profiles, concurrent paired recorder, persistence and blind actual-consumed-GLRT support remain required.
Graceful map disable during FILL increments discontinuity_abort_count in present RTL; keep failing terminal health receipt until explicit tested terminal-discard or stop-at-boundary contract exists.
